items.source: Converts the given object into one Mongo will be able to store natively but retains the type information in case the given TypeInformation differs from the given object type.
items.translation: 将给定对象转换为 MongoDB 能够原生存储的对象，但如果给定的 TypeInformation 与给定对象类型不同，则保留类型信息。

items.source: Creates a the DocumentPointer representing the link to another entity.
items.translation: 创建一个DocumentPointer，表示指向另一个实体的链接。

items.source: Creates a DBRef to refer to the given object.
items.translation: 创建一个 `DBRef` 以引用给定对象。

items.source: referringProperty - the client-side property referring to the object which might carry additional metadata for the DBRef object to create. Can be null.
items.translation: referringProperty - 客户端属性，指向可能携带额外元数据的对象，用于创建 DBRef 对象。可为 null。

items.source: A MongoWriter is responsible for converting an object of type T to the native MongoDB representation Document.
items.translation: MongoWriter 负责将类型为 T 的对象转换为原生的 MongoDB 表示形式 Document。

items.source: Converts the given object into one Mongo will be able to store natively.
items.translation: 将给定对象转换为 MongoDB 能够原生存储的格式。

items.source:
Converts the given object into one Mongo will be able to store natively. If the given object can already be stored
as is, no conversion will happen.
items.translation: 将给定对象转换为 MongoDB 能够原生存储的格式。如果给定对象已经可以直接存储，则不会进行转换。

items.source: T - the type of the object to convert to a Document
items.translation: T - 要转换为 Document 的对象类型

items.source: object - the object to create a DBRef to link to. The object's type has to carry an id attribute.
items.translation: object - 要创建指向的 DBRef 的对象。该对象的类型必须包含一个 id 属性。

items.source: source - the object to create a document link to.
items.translation: source - 要创建文档链接的对象。

items.source: Mark Pollack, Thomas Risberg, Oliver Gierke, Christoph Strobl
